solar-system.prompt: Describe how the solar wind leads to auroras on Earth.

keyPoints: The solar wind is a stream of charged particles from the Sun.
Earth's magnetic field deflects most of the particles.
Some particles are channelled towards the poles.
There they make the air glow, creating the aurora.

solar-system.prompt: Explain how Jupiter's strong gravity influenced the formation of the asteroid belt.

keyPoints: Its gravity affected the material between Mars and Jupiter.
This is thought to have prevented that material from forming a planet.
The region remains a belt of many separate asteroids.
